# Krityam

> Krityam is a done-for-you AI automation service for Indian D2C and e-commerce brands. We build and run systems that cut RTO (Return to Origin) on cash-on-delivery orders, raise average order value and bring customers back for repeat purchases.

## Who it's for

- D2C and e-commerce brands in India doing roughly ₹40L–₹1Cr in monthly revenue
- Brands with meaningful COD volume and a high RTO rate
- Founders, directors and CXOs who want fewer manual operations, without hiring more people

Not a fit for brands with very low order volume, or brands not ready to share order and delivery data.

## What we do

1. Revenue Leak Audit™: after onboarding, we analyse the brand's RTO, COD, delivery and customer data to find high-RTO pincodes, products, segments and order patterns, and build an AI score that ranks every order as safer or riskier to ship.
2. RTO Prevention Engine™: voice AI agents confirm COD orders before dispatch; WhatsApp automations handle unreachable customers, address issues and NDR (non-delivery report) follow-ups; high-risk orders go to AI or human intervention.
3. LTV Growth Engine™: voice AI and WhatsApp upsell, cross-sell, reorder and win-back campaigns, with customers segmented by behaviour.

Brands also get a live analytics dashboard covering RTO, recovered revenue, AOV and LTV.

## How engagements work

- It starts with a free 30-minute discovery call to discuss the brand's problems and whether Krityam is the right fit.
- Done for you: one onboarding session, a dedicated account manager, a weekly 30-minute optimisation call and a monthly leadership review. Krityam handles the build, integration and upkeep.
- Works with the brand's current store and courier setup.
- The larger part of the fee is due only after the brand sees its RTO drop.
- Support: Monday–Friday, 10 AM–6 PM IST on a dedicated WhatsApp line.
